description: Safe value wrapper used by the stencil expression evaluator. Wraps a raw object (often a JsonElement) and exposes total, never-throwing conversions, so a malformed stencil expression degrades to a default instead of crashing the renderer.

examples.title: Use StencilValue

members.name: Raw
members.description: The wrapped value; may be a JsonElement, a primitive, or null.

members.name: IsNull
members.description: True when the value is null or a JSON null/undefined element.

members.name: AsString
members.description: Converts the value to a string; returns an empty string when null.

members.name: AsDouble
members.description: Converts the value to a double; returns 0 when the value is not numeric.

members.name: AsBool
members.description: Converts the value to a bool; returns false when the value is not truthy.
